scope.source: pg_catalog only; no Auth/application rows or row counts
scope.triggers: all sessions attachments plus users DELETE and inbound sessions-FK attachments
scope.attachedFunctions: fingerprints only for selected trigger function OIDs in any schema; no execution

limits: Catalog fingerprints only; no managed Auth migration lineage, raw source recovery or complete baseline adoption.
No Auth/user/session rows, identifiers, row counts, credentials, configuration values or helper execution.
Effective privileges are dated metadata, not permission to grant access or a strict-session/native-role authorization path.
No logout, termination, timebox/inactivity, JWT/API behavior, lock-order/all-writer concurrency, financial, recovery or release acceptance.
